description: Dam site E, upper Cotter River, ACT is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. In March 1946 the Department of Works and Housing requested that a geological examination be made of the Upper Cotter Valley in the vicinity of Kangaroo Creek to determine whether a dam could be constructed near the junction of Kangaroo Creek with the Cotter River. A geological examination was subsequently made. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data.
